'''October 2000 Phoenix tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Gamer's Edge, Phoenix, AZ on 1 October 2000. [[Chris Shaner]] won it. It is known from Enrique Huerta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1288">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-02-phoenix-az-10-01-00d1288/ phoenix-az-10-01-00], DeckTech (Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta, 2 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-02-phoenix-az-10-01-00d1288/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Gamer's Edge, Phoenix, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Shaner]]
